title: huddle.json
description: Configuration of Huddle for one repository. No secrets ever go in it.

project.description: owner/repo on GitHub, or the project path (groups allowed) on GitLab.

ai_manager.description: Login of the AI Manager: the only person whose comments count as requests.

assignees.description: Logins of the team that get ready Issues.

max_open_per_person.description: Nobody gets more open Issues than this.

staging_branch.description: Optional. The branch where changes are tested before they go to the default branch. Empty or absent means none. Must differ from default_branch and be a plain branch name (docs/design.md §21). Stored only for now.

labels_job.description: Optional. How the cloud labels job runs (docs/design.md §23). sessions (default when absent): no cloud job, no CI minutes, the sessions keep the labels right. hourly: once an hour and on a manual run, a safety net for a team where changes may happen outside a session. events: on every Issue, PR and comment event; it uses a lot of CI minutes.

testers.description: Optional. Logins, besides the AI Manager, whose «✅ Tested in staging» comment counts as the marker that an Issue was tested in staging (docs/design.md §21). Empty by default.

progress_issue.description: false turns off the «Huddle progress» Issue that `huddle labels` keeps up to date. Default: true.

clean_worktrees.description: false stops the session start from removing finished worktrees (clean, merged into the default branch, untouched for 24 hours). `huddle clean` still works by hand. Default: true.

labels_on_start.description: false stops the session start from running a background pass of `huddle labels --no-assign` that corrects the labels (at most once every 10 minutes). It runs whatever labels_job says: it is local and free. Default: true.

setup_version.description: The Huddle release this repo was last set up or updated for (major.minor.patch). Written by setup and update, never by hand.

labels.description: Optional renames of the seven status labels.
